subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should Telegram ACP allow multiple same-account sessions to remain independently bound to one group topic, or should a new bind intentionally hand ownership to the newest session?
rationale: The PR title and body describe independent multi-agent bindings, but the branch implements last-writer-wins and also adds a new cross-account fail-closed fence that can change existing topic workflows.

options.title: Require Independent Bindings
options.body: Preserve the stated multi-agent workflow by storing/routing multiple same-account topic bindings without replacing the earlier session.

options.title: Accept Same-Account Handoff
options.body: Treat a same-account rebind as an explicit ownership switch, then update the PR description, tests, and proof to match that behavior.

options.title: Pause Cross-Account Fence
options.body: Defer the new cross-bot-account rejection until maintainers decide whether current shared-topic setups may break.

recommendation.title: Require Independent Bindings
recommendation.body: Preserve the stated multi-agent workflow by storing/routing multiple same-account topic bindings without replacing the earlier session.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the Telegram ACP topic-binding feature introduced in the original merged topic-binding work.
